doc: Where quest 1's stage (collect_call_stage.json + collect_call_places.json, stage metres) sits on the generated city: world = origin + stage * squash. The stage is laid along one east-west street so every leg Rivet walks stays on it; origin found by res://dev/quest1_city_fit.gd (re-fit 2026-11-03 for the 12 m streets, was 276, 265.85; the 12 m kerb strip moved the clear y) (every place and walked leg clear of buildings, props and parked cars).
